title: ISic003403. Fragment of a monumental Greek inscription
body:
Text encoding: Jonathan Prag; edition source: autopsy Prag 2026-09-17, in storage in the Neapolis archaeological park.
1[---]ΣΚΑΤΑ[---]

Text encoding: Jonathan Prag; edition source: autopsy Prag 2026-09-17, in storage in the Neapolis archaeological park.
1[---]ΣΚΑΤΑ[---]

Facsimile Images

Apparatus criticus

  • Text from autopsy

translation

commentary

The style of the lettering (in scale, letter types, and the use of red paint on a white ground) shows considerable similarity with the monumental blocks recovered from Castello Eurialo (ISic002747). Attribution to building works by Hieron II is obviously tempting, but far from certain.

bibliography

  • Orsi NSA 1889 371 https://biblio.inscriptiones.org/epig10001392
  • Kaibel 1890 15b https://biblio.inscriptiones.org/epig10001072
  • Orsi 2018 Tacc. 2, p. 74 https://biblio.inscriptiones.org/epig10002617

Elegant deep (14mm), v-cut letters of regular form. Kappa with short equal arms; sigma deep with slightly outward curving top and bottom strokes; alpha wide with straight bar.

Line 1 185-205 Interlineation line 1 to 2 NA
